content.title: Advancing Cybersecurity Education and Workforce Development
content.text: Advancing Cybersecurity Education and Workforce Development We believe K-12 cybersecurity education is the key to solving the cyber workforce shortage. Our goal is to empower educators as they prepare the next generation to succeed in the cyber workforce of tomorrow. Intro Text Title Our Purpose in Action Intro Text Content To build a resilient and future-ready cyber workforce, it starts with empowering the educators and leaders who will shape it. Across K–12, higher education, and workforce training programs, many institutions lack teachers with the confidence, expertise, or resources to effectively teach cybersecurity. CYBER.ORG, the academic initiative of the Cyber Innovation Center (CIC) bridges that gap by preparing educators to lead cybersecurity instruction in critical cyber standards and best practices. Main Content Who We Serve WYSIWYG You want to inspire the next generation of cyber professionals, but don’t have the funding or time to invest in another overly technical resource. You need something affordable, practical and built for the classroom. WYSIWYG You want to build cyber programs but lack trained staff and aren’t sure where to start. You need something accessible and scalable. WYSIWYG You want to prepare students for real careers in cybersecurity but lack effective resources. You need something focused on industry certification objectives. CYBER.ORG continues to promote cybersecurity careers through the use of its career profiles.Students can explore the searchable web-based profiles, which include engaging graphics, sample job tasks, salary information, and, in some cases, video interviews with real cybersecurity professionals.Download our full set of career profile cards and posters to connect classroom learning with real-world job roles and help students envision their future in the world of cybersecurity. Short, animated videos that break down important cybersecurity concepts that students should know as digital citizens.Video Call SafetyOnline Gaming SafetyMaking Strong PasswordsPhishingRansomwareSocial MediaInternet of ThingsMultifactor AuthenticationInterested in using these resources as bell ringers or exit tickets? Check out our Kahoots for each video! Kahoot! is a game-based platform that makes learning fun, fast-paced, and interactive—perfect for engaging students in the classroom.CYBER.ORG offers a collection of Kahoot! cyber trivia quizzes ideal for lesson warm-ups, quick reviews, or end-of-class activities. These quizzes encourage student participation and spark classroom competition while reinforcing key cybersecurity concepts.
